$comment: r323 contrast-gate NAMED EXEMPTIONS. An entry is a documented decision, never a silent ignore: it names the seat, the route, the measured ratio, and WHY the value is held. The gate keeps sweeping the element and still records every finding in contrast-gate.json under `exempted` — only a finding that matches an entry below stops failing the run. Adding an entry requires the measured numbers in it; the gate re-measures them on every run and reports drift.

exemptions.reason: The landing hero's secondary link is a FROZEN Heron seat: --accent (#FA3600) ink on the paper ground is the measured reference value the Heron conformance record holds at rest (rgb(250,54,0) on rgb(246,246,238) = 3.46:1). Recolouring it moves a frozen art seat owned by the landing conformance lane, not a defect to fix here. Size makes it legal for large text only if it grows; it is a secondary CTA, so the ratio is recorded, accepted and re-measured every run.
